original: mahato vṛkṣātparṇaṃ patati | vṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ | ākāro vyāpini śakunayaḥ santi | evaṃ dvivacanabahuvacane'pi pratipattavye | yadyeva kathaṃ viṃśatiḥ kaṭāḥ kriyante iti | satyaṃ svabhāvāt‌ viṃśatiśabdo'yaṃ ekavacanāṃta eva bhavati iti viśeṣyasya vibhaktimātramupādatte | evamanyadapi vijñeyam‌ |
analyzed: mahataḥ vṛkṣāt parṇam patati vṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ākāraḥ vyāpini śakunayaḥ santi evam dvivacana bahuvacane api pratipattavye yadi eva katham viṃśatiḥ kaṭāḥ kriyante iti satyam svabhāvāt viṃśati śabdaḥ yam ekavacana aṃtaḥ eva bhavati iti viśeṣyasya vibhakti mātram upādatte evam anyat api vijñeyam

original: nanu tathāpi kriyante iti kathaṃ bahuvacanaṃ viṃśitorekavacanāṃtatvādataha kaṭā iti bahuvacanāṃtena padena saṃbaṃdahadadoṣaḥ | nanu bhavatu mā maivam‌ | tathāpi kriyāpadasya pratyekamabhisaṃbaṃdho anaṃtaramupadarśitaḥ | tato viṃśatiśabdasaṃbaṃdhādekavacanamapi prāpnoti | na kevalaṃ kaṭā iti saṃbaṃdhādbahuvacanam‌ |
analyzed: nanu tathā api kriyante iti katham bahuvacanam kaṭāḥ iti bahuvacana aṃtena padena saṃbaṃda hat adoṣaḥ nanu bhavatu mā mā evam tathā api kriyā padasya pratyekam abhisaṃbaṃdhaḥ anaṃtaram upadarśitaḥ tatas viṃśati śabda saṃbaṃdhāt ekavacanam api prāpnoti na kevalam kaṭāḥ iti saṃbaṃdhāt bahuvacanam

original: satyaṃ pradhanatvādviśeṣyasya tatsaṃkhyāmevopādatte ityādi yathā taṃtavaḥ paṭīkriyante iti pradhānatvāt‌ prakṛtisaṃkhyā | atra hi taṃtavaḥ prakṛtibhūtāḥ | pradhānaṃ vikārastu tanmūlatvādapradhānaṃ paṭaḥ | evaṃ kṛttaddhitasamāseṣvapi vaktavyaḥ | tadyathā | viṃśatiḥ kaṭāḥ krītāḥ | viṃśatirvaiyākaraṇāḥ |
analyzed: satyam pradhana tvāt viśeṣyasya tat saṃkhyām eva upādatte ityādi yathā taṃtavaḥ paṭīkriyante iti pradhāna tvāt prakṛti saṃkhyā atra hi taṃtavaḥ prakṛti bhūtāḥ pradhānam vikāraḥ tu tad mūla tvāt apradhānam paṭaḥ evam kṛt taddhita samāseṣu api vaktavyaḥ tat yathā viṃśatiḥ kaṭāḥ krītāḥ viṃśatiḥ vaiyākaraṇāḥ

original: viṃśatiḥ puruṣāḥ kṛtapraṇāmā ityādi viśeṣyasya liṃgasaṃkhye samānādhikaraṇe viśeṣaṇe pratipattavye | pradhānaṃ puruṣa ityādau punaḥ aviṣṭaliṃgatvātpradhānādayo na viśeṣyasya liṃgaṃ bhajante iti | ata eva liṃgasaṃkhyetyādikāyāṃ prāyo'bhihitamiti | tadevamuktānuktam | pratipādyavibhaktiṃ ca darśayitvā niyamannāha | nirnayastāvadīdṛśaḥ |
analyzed: viṃśatiḥ puruṣāḥ kṛta praṇāmāḥ ityādi viśeṣyasya liṃga saṃkhye samāna adhikaraṇe viśeṣaṇe pratipattavye pradhānam puruṣaḥ ityādau punar a viṣṭa liṃga tvāt pradhāna ādayaḥ na viśeṣyasya liṃgam bhajante iti atas eva liṃga saṃkhyā ityādikāyām prāyas abhihitam iti tat evam ukta anuktam pratipādya vibhaktim ca darśayitvā niyaman āha nirnayaḥ tāvat īdṛśaḥ

original: uktānuktavicāreṇa prayogastena gamyatām ||
analyzed: ukta anukta vicāreṇa prayogaḥ tena gamyatām

original: uktānuktavicāreṇa prayogastena gamyatāmiti | tāvatśabdaḥ kramāpekṣayā īdṛśastā ca hetunā uktānuktavicārena prayogo gamyatām | devadattena kaṭaḥ kriyate ityādi rupaṃ vākyaṃ sādhyasādhanalakṣaṇaṃ gamyatām‌ | pratipādyatām‌ | kriyantāmiti yāvat‌ | śiṣyairiti saṃbaṃdhaḥ | gamyatāmiti gamerinaṃtasya rupamidam‌ |
analyzed: ukta anukta vicāreṇa prayogaḥ tena gamyatām iti tāvat śabdaḥ krama apekṣayā īdṛśaḥ tā ca hetunā ukta anukta vicārena prayogaḥ gamyatām devadattena kaṭaḥ kriyate ityādi rupam vākyam sādhya sādhana lakṣaṇam gamyatām pratipādyatām kriyantām iti yāvat śiṣyaiḥ iti saṃbaṃdhaḥ gamyatām iti rupam idam

original: gamyamānārthasya prayogaṃ pratikāmacāra iti śloke śiṣyairiti noktam‌ | tadyathā | parvataḥ sumerurityevāyaṃ prayogaḥ | tatra sādhyate iti sādhyaṃ kriyādhātvarthaḥ | kriyācayena sādhyate tatsādhanaṃ kārakaṣaṭkam‌ | yathoktaṃ kriyānimittaṃ kārakaṃ lokataḥ siddham‌ | yena ca padasamudāyena sādhyaṃ sādhanaṃ ca pratipādyate | tadvākyaṃ vaktavyam |
analyzed: gamyamāna arthasya prayogam prati kāma cāraḥ iti śloke śiṣyaiḥ iti na uktam tat yathā parvataḥ sumeruḥ iti eva ayam prayogaḥ tatra sādhyate iti sādhyam kriyā dhātvarthaḥ kriyā cayena sādhyate tat sādhanam kāraka ṣaṭkam yathā uktam kriyā nimittam kārakam lokataḥ siddham yena ca pada samudāyena sādhyam sādhanam ca pratipādyate tat vākyam vaktavyam

original: tata eva hi śabdo vyavahāraḥ pravartate | tasyaiva nirākāṃkṣatayā pravṛttinivṛttihetutvāt‌ | tadyathā | agnihotraṃ juhuyāt‌ svargakāma ityādi vākyaṃ pravṛttihetuḥ | brāhmaṇo na haṃtavyaḥ ityādi nivṛttihetukam‌ | na caivaṃ kevalasya padasya pravṛttinivṛttihetutvaṃ kvacid‌ bhūyate |
analyzed: tatas eva hi śabdaḥ vyavahāraḥ pravartate tasya eva nirākāṃkṣa tayā pravṛtti nivṛtti hetu tvāt tat yathā agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ ityādi vākyam pravṛtti hetuḥ brāhmaṇaḥ na haṃtavyaḥ ityādi nivṛtti hetukam na ca evam kevalasya padasya pravṛtti nivṛtti hetu tvam kvacid bhūyate

original: ataḥ śābdo vyavahāraḥ kriyamāṇo bahubhireva pādaiḥ kartavya iti jñātvā'pi padasiddhimekaikaśaḥ kadācit‌ maṃdamatayo bahupadayojanāyāṃ janāḥ saṃdihīran‌ | ataḥ kārakasaṃbaṃdhodyotasaṃpādayannāha sthita evāyamasmākaṃ tānuddiśya pariśrama iti |
analyzed: atas śābdaḥ vyavahāraḥ kriyamāṇaḥ bahubhiḥ eva pādaiḥ kartavyaḥ iti jñātvā api pada siddhim ekaikaśas kadācid maṃda matayaḥ bahu pada yojanāyām janāḥ saṃdihīran atas kāraka saṃbaṃdha udyota saṃpādayan āha sthitaḥ eva ayam asmākam tān uddiśya pariśramaḥ iti
